design.accelerator_backend: float64 batched C0 X5 on CUDA when available
design.cpu_backend: float64 X5 batched C0 on CPU
design.authority_rule: a node may become terminal EMPTY only if CPU confirms the same strict sign after an accelerator decisive proposal
design.accelerator_unknown_rule: remain active without CPU verification; false UNKNOWN only reduces pruning efficiency
design.accelerator_false_decisive_rule: CPU rejection converts the node back to active and it is refined if depth remains

correctness_gates: CPU-only accelerator emulation matches X5 ladder on deterministic fixtures
injected false-positive accelerator decisive proposals are rejected by CPU confirmation
confirmed terminals are a subset of CPU-X5 decisive terminals
no terminal sign may disagree with CPU-X5
